title: บอกเหตุผลง่าย ๆ ว่าจะไปสาย

scenario: You are running a little late and need to explain the reason.
learner_goal: Apologize, give one simple reason, and estimate the delay.
register_notes: Friendly, low-stakes Thai. Uses ขอโทษนะ and short everyday reason; avoids emergency, workplace, or formal-excuse framing.
